attributes.title: Codex CLI — Tool Results
attributes.description: Tool-result events (labels.event_name: codex.tool_result) for the codex-cli agent — tool name / origin / mcp flag / success / duration plus argument & output sizes. Filtered on labels.event_name, Codex's event-type field (NOT claude's message). Documented departure from the claude convention: NO user_email lead — these trace_safe-family docs carry no identity envelope (user_email rides the log_only twin; the joined ES|QL view restores it). Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Codex CLI — Events data view.
